content.text: {"stops":[{"poi_id":"p10","kind":"activity","must_do_id":null,"note":"Shoes off, phone down, eyes up. The nightingale floors squeak like gossip."},{"poi_id":"p12","kind":"activity","must_do_id":null,"note":"A thousand wooden faces, each one quietly judging your posture."}]}

{"stops":[{"poi_id":"p1","kind":"activity","must_do_id":"m1","note":"Foxes watch from every torii; let the mountain pull you up before the crowds find it."},{"poi_id":"p14","kind":"activity","must_do_id":"m2","note":"Steam, steel and the roundhouse echo; even the non-train people go quiet here."}]}

{"stops":[{"poi_id":"p5","kind":"activity","must_do_id":null,"note":"Go early, before the selfie sticks wake up, and let the bamboo do the talking."},{"poi_id":"p6","kind":"activity","must_do_id":"m3","note":"Shoes off, phone down, eyes up in the garden; the pond has been showing off for centuries."},{"poi_id":"p2","kind":"activity","must_do_id":"m4","note":"The gold leaf is not subtle, and neither should your camera be."}]}

{"stops":[{"poi_id":"p4","kind":"activity","must_do_id":"m5","note":"Snack your way through the market like a tanuki with a very small basket."},{"poi_id":"p19","kind":"meal","must_do_id":null,"note":"Quiet plates, kind to every appetite in the crew."},{"poi_id":"p7","kind":"activity","must_do_id":null,"note":"Walk slowly here; the old wooden fronts reward a lingering look."},{"poi_id":"p13","kind":"activity","must_do_id":null,"note":"Lantern light, narrow lanes, and the feeling Kyoto is winking at you."},{"poi_id":"p19","kind":"meal","must_do_id":null,"note":"A gentle dinner before the evening air turns properly cold."}]}

{"stops":[{"poi_id":"p3","kind":"activity","must_do_id":null,"note":"Shoes off, phone down, eyes up. The wooden stage leans over the maples like it’s listening."},{"poi_id":"p11","kind":"activity","must_do_id":null,"note":"Quiet halls, old bronze, and a garden that knows how to hold its breath."},{"poi_id":"p8","kind":"activity","must_do_id":null,"note":"A canal path that strolls better than most people. Let the ducks set the pace."},{"poi_id":"p9","kind":"activity","must_do_id":null,"note":"The silver pavilion never got its silver. Still glows like a rumour."}]}
Evening Gion, then temples, trains, gold and a castle — every must-do tucked in, shoes off, phone down.
